answer: Operator Liability Escrow: each registered identity posts a small escrow owned by its operator, not the wallet. If any identity in an operator's cluster triggers a fraud proof, the operator's entire escrow is seized and further registrations require a doubling deposit. An orchard of sock-puppets therefore exposes one shared pool; a single relic of misbehaviour drains every planting. Sybils pay per-identity escrow plus cluster-wide forfeiture, so N fakes cost N deposits against one slash. A whisper of collusion suffices to trigger it.
